leadText: Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.
plainText:
Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Scizor Defends
Hawlucha Attack
Pinsir Changes
Zygarde Appears
Malamar Traps
Chesnaught Protects

==Important events==
 

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Y's "Solsol" in PS583.
X's "Rute" in PS583.

===Evolutions===
Y's "Croaky" evolves into in PS587.
X's "Marisso" evolves into in PS588.
X's "Salamè" evolves into in PS589.
